stdout:
Build kit for "and a rows the navigation"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        settings-sidebar
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Preferences split into nav-switched panels: a persistent section list swaps the pane beside it, and rows edit in place rather than opening a separate form.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template settings-sidebar --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: shell-top-nav (@astryxdesign/core), theme-showcase (@astryxdesign/core), table (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        TreeListNavigationTree
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Navigation tree with a selected item for the current page.

name:        SideNavWithHeaderMenu
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Side navigation with an account switcher dropdown in the header for multi-account apps.

name:        SideNavNestedItems
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Side navigation with collapsible nested items for settings or hierarchical...

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 6; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A vertical collection of items with consistent spacing, dividers, and optional markers.

description: Manages keyboard navigation within a 2D grid following the WAI-ARIA grid pattern.

name:        useListFocus
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Manages keyboard navigation within a linear list following WAI-ARIA menu/listbox/toolbar patterns.
